pos.title: New transaction
pos.subtitle: Select a business engine to begin serving the customer

engine.chooseProduct: Choose what the customer is taking
engine.fulfilNote: Payment is done. The timer starts only when you confirm fulfilment.
engine.paymentNote: Payment records the sale and confirms the booking — it does <1>not</1> start any operational timer.

toast.trackIt: Track it in the booking or Operations.

engine.draftNotReleased: The draft could not be released — reload and try again.
engine.customerIncomplete: This customer has no complete mobile number, so they cannot be sent a code or an invoice. Edit them before taking payment.
engine.chooseUnit: Which one are you handing over?
engine.chooseUnitHint: The operational number written on the vehicle.
engine.noFreeUnits: Nothing of this kind is free at your desk right now.

shopdrop.title: Shop & Drop
shopdrop.subtitle: Bag storage & retrieval — the primary MVP workflow
shopdrop.scanToStore: Scan each bag and the compartment to store them
shopdrop.oneBarcode: One unique barcode per physical bag
shopdrop.reservationNote: Post-payment, an AssetReservation locks one physical unit so no other booking can take it.
shopdrop.couriersCanSee: Couriers at this site can see it now.
shopdrop.wantBagsBrought: Want the bags brought to them?
shopdrop.askNow: Ask now while they are here — arranging it later means verifying them over the phone first.
shopdrop.heldNotReleased: The held compartment could not be released — reload and try again.
shopdrop.bookingConfirmed: Booking confirmed — timer NOT started yet.
shopdrop.bagsIntro: Enter each bag's type, size and weight so the system can suggest the best-fit compartment. Each bag gets one unique barcode; multiple bags may share one compartment.

operations.title: Active operations
operations.subtitle: Live sessions across all engines at this station
operations.emptyMessage: Confirmed fulfilments appear here with live timers.

bookings.title: Bookings
bookings.subtitle: All transactions at this station
bookings.emptyMessage: Bookings appear here as they are created.

bookingDetail.noActions: No actions available in this state.
bookingDetail.timerNotStarted: Timer not started — awaiting a fulfilment action (never payment).
bookingDetail.manualBarcode: Manual barcode (scan out / test wrong-bag rejection)
bookingDetail.verifyRequired: Retrieval is locked until the customer's identity is verified.
bookingDetail.stillRefundable: {{amount}} of this booking is still refundable.
bookingDetail.refundAmountHint: Defaults to everything the customer paid. Lower it for a partial refund.
bookingDetail.refundReasonHint: This is recorded against the booking and in the tenant audit trail.
bookingDetail.refundNote: The money goes back the way it came in — cash leaves the till, a card refund follows the same scheme — and the accountant sees it as a refund in the VAT return.
bookingDetail.refundOnly: Only {{amount}} is left to refund on this booking.
bookingDetail.refundRecordedDetail: {{amount}} returned in total on {{ref}}. It is on the booking and in the audit trail.
bookingDetail.reassignHint: Requires a reason — logged to the audit trail

customers.title: Customers
customers.subtitle: Everyone served at this station
customers.emptyMessage: Add one from here or during a booking.

assets.title: Assets — Digital Twin
assets.subtitle: Live status of every compartment, vehicle, boat and table
assets.emptyMessage: Units provisioned for this station appear here.

incidents.title: Incidents
incidents.subtitle: Operational exceptions & disputes
incidents.emptyMessage: Nothing has been reported at this station.
incidents.typeHint: Decides which categories apply — a scooter cannot have a missing bag.

shift.title: Shift & reconciliation
shift.subtitle: Blind cash count and close-out
shift.noOpenShift: No open shift at this station.
shift.supervisorNote: The system makes no assumption about deductions — a supervisor records the approved resolution per tenant policy.
shift.blindCountHint: Count the physical cash in the drawer and enter the amount. The expected total stays hidden until you submit.
shift.openTillTitle: Your till is open — open the shift page to count and close it
shift.closedTillTitle: Your till is shut, so nothing can be sold yet
shift.openTillBlurb: Nothing can be sold, extended or settled at this desk until the drawer is open.
shift.openingFloatHint: The change counted into the drawer before the first customer. Leave it at zero if there is none.
shift.openedToastDetail: The drawer starts on {{amount}}. It closes on the shift page, by counting it.

signOut.stillOpen: You still have work open at this desk.
signOut.tillOpenHint: Count and close it so the day reconciles against your name.

trips.title: Boats & trips
trips.subtitle: Everyone who has paid and is waiting for a boat, grouped into trips a captain can take.
trips.groupedDetail: {{count}} trip(s) are waiting for a captain.
trips.nobodyWaitingHint: Paid lagoon bookings show up here, grouped by the boat they asked for.
trips.noTripsHint: Group the people waiting and the trips appear here.
trips.captainSubtitle: Take a trip, sail it, and clock each station you reach.
trips.nothingUnderwayHint: Take a trip from the list, then cast off.
trips.clockAStation: Clock a station as you reach it
trips.finishedDetail: {{ref}} is closed and the boat is free again.
trips.noneFinishedHint: Trips you close appear here with the road you sailed.

voyage.title: Chart & sail
voyage.subtitle: Plan the road across the lagoon, then clock each jetty as you reach it.
voyage.noStops: No jetty is on the map yet.
voyage.nothingPlanned: Tap the jetties on the map in the order you will sail them.
voyage.pickHint: Tap a jetty to add it to the road; tap it again to take it off. The numbers are the order you will sail.
voyage.noTripHint: Take a trip from your board and it will appear here with the chart.
voyage.noMapYet: Nobody has placed the jetties on the map yet — ask the CEO to set the station map.
voyage.roadFirst: Plan the road first — tap the jetties on the chart in the order you will sail them.
voyage.saveFirst: Save the road before casting off.
